audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated this TRICKY at 7.5/10 with an 8/10 carry threat, on a page whose own content says Nautilus wins five of seven stages and 'she never beats me in a straight 1v1'.
audit.why: Lillia has no hard CC before 6, no dash that escapes a landed pull, and a squishy AP skirmisher frame. The mirror audit rated the lane 7/10 HARD from Lillia's side with a 7/10 carry threat — the inverse of that is a favoured, not tricky, lane for Nautilus. The 58.33% win rate over 12 Emerald+ games points the same way.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone #e8b84b, diffRating 4.5/10, carryRating 7/10, with breakdown.difficulty, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late and report[14].t re-stated to the same numbers.
sources: content late: 'She never beats me in a straight 1v1'

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows named the wrong winner in both layers — rows 0-2 said Skill against whys that say Nautilus wins outright, rows 3 and 5 said Lillia against whys that call them even, and row 6 said Skill against a why that says she never out-duels him.
audit.why: whys[0] 'makes every trade favor me'; whys[2] 'she physically can't bounce out of a full chain'; whys[3] 'Even'; whys[5] 'comes down to hooking on her cooldowns'; whys[6] 'She out-mobilities but never out-duels me'. The packet chart reads Nautilus/Nautilus/Nautilus/Skill/Lillia/Skill/Nautilus and the mirror audit set exactly that chart with ratings 3,3,3,5,6,5,3 from her side.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Nautilus, rows 3 and 5 to Skill, row 6 to Nautilus, all as matched full+content pairs; ratings inverted to 7,7,7,5,4,5,7; the six why strings rewritten to state the real reason. Row 4 stays Lillia — Lilting Lullaby genuinely flips the stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the one condition on Lilting Lullaby — it only sleeps enemies who already carry Dream Dust — and never mentions that Blooming Blows' outer edge deals true damage, so armour and MR do not read that trade.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep', 150/130/110s cooldown. enemyKit Q: 'dealing extra true damage on the edge', 6s at rank 1, with the trueDamage flag; the missingInteractions file flags resistances-invalidated for exactly this. Both change how the player reads her threat: dodge the dust and the 150-second ult does nothing to you.
audit.corrected: Lilting Lullaby's 150s cooldown and Dream Dust precondition written into report[5].t; Blooming Blows' 6s cooldown and true-damage edge into dosFull[0].d; Swirlseed named in phases[3].why.

edits.before: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Identify how Lillia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Passive-root auto trades win the first exchanges. Lillia has no hard CC before 6 and her poke is only damage-over-time chip.

edits.before: Hook threat changes where he can stand forever. Only take the trade when Lillia's Blooming Blows is down.
edits.after: With W shield or E slow at 2 you walk her down — she has no dash yet that fully escapes your Riptide.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lillia must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Dredge Line into passive root into E slow, and she physically cannot bounce out of the whole chain.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blooming Blows's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even here: her W spin and Swirlseed bounce dodge a telegraphed anchor, so the stage turns entirely on whether your 14s hook lands clean.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blooming Blows's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet eats her burn and a clean hook still locks her — even, on her dash cooldowns.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Lillia carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: she out-mobilities you but never out-duels you — land R as the opener and the lockdown still kills her.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blooming Blows and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Blooming Blows and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Carry threat: 8/10. If Lillia gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 7/10. If Lillia gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — build your teamfight around that. Lillia carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — build your teamfight around that. Lillia carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Lillia carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 4.5/10, Lillia carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and its edge deals true damage.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Hook + passive root chain.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and only sleeps you if her Dream Dust is already on you. Hook, root, slow.
